'''Andra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Freeworlds Common Navy]] and commanded a cruiser during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A dignified and distinguished looking man in his fifties, Andra was a career military man who graduated from the [[Neona Military Academy]]. He was said to have little patience for fools or snobs. The Andra family had a very ancient lineage, and once belonged to a [[Tapani Noble Houses|noble house]] that was long disbanded when the [[Freeworlds Territory|Freeworlds]] ceded from the [[Expanse]]. When he was not patrolling the [[Shapani Bypass/Legends|Shapani Bypass]], Captain Andra could be found attending a number of parties on the freeworlds and occasionally on [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]].<ref name="LOTE" />
